VC125.question: What must a radio amateur who commits an administrative offence when operating an amateur station expect?

VC120.question: In the case of home-built equipment, may a radio amateur deviate from the essential requirements on immunity within the meaning of the Act on the Electromagnetic Compatibility of Equipment (EMVG)?

VC119.answer_a: The radio amateur may deviate from the essential requirements under the Act on the Electromagnetic Compatibility of Equipment (EMVG) and can personally determine the degree of immunity of the amateur station.
